name: Input
purpose: Single-line text entry: names, emails, references, amounts. Not for multi-line text, dates or selections.
description: The text field primitive. Labelled by contract (TypeScript requires an id for a visible label, or aria-label / aria-labelledby), with adornments for currency symbols and units, an `invalid` state wired to aria-invalid, and `align="end"` for money. Formatting of money and numbers belongs to the consumer until the NumberField ships.

type.description: HTML input type. number is unformatted; for currency, format in the consumer and keep type="text" with inputMode="decimal".

size.description: 28, 32 or 40 px tall, matching Button sizes so they line up in a row.
size.a11y: All sizes meet the 24 px minimum target size.

align.description: end switches on tabular numerals and right-aligns. Use for amounts.

invalid.description: Shows the critical border and sets aria-invalid. Always pair with a visible message linked via aria-describedby.
invalid.a11y: aria-invalid=true is announced; the message must be in the DOM and linked.

disabled.a11y: Disabled fields leave the tab order. Prefer readOnly when the value must still be readable.

readOnly.description: Readable and focusable, not editable. Sunken background.
readOnly.a11y: Read-only fields stay in the tab order and are announced as read-only.

placeholder.description: Example value, not a label. Meets 4.5:1 but disappears on typing.

startAdornment.description: Decorative prefix: an Icon or a currency symbol.

endAdornment.description: Decorative suffix: a unit such as USD or %.

id.description: Required when a visible label uses htmlFor.

keyboard: Escape clears a type="search" field in most browsers
a11y.name: From a visible label via id + htmlFor (preferred), or aria-label / aria-labelledby. TypeScript requires one of the three.
notes: Border meets 3:1 non-text contrast against the field background in both themes; the invalid border is the critical colour.
Placeholder text meets 4.5:1 but is never the label.
Adornments are aria-hidden. If the unit matters, say it in the label: "Amount (USD)".
Error messages are linked with aria-describedby so they are announced with the field.

rules: Every Input has a visible label (Text as="label" htmlFor) unless it is a search box with aria-label.
Amounts use align="end" and inputMode="decimal"; the consumer formats the value.
invalid is always accompanied by a message linked via aria-describedby.
Use readOnly, not disabled, for values the user must still be able to read and copy.
dos: Put the currency symbol in startAdornment and the code in endAdornment: $ … USD.
Match Input size to the Button beside it.
donts: Do not use placeholder as the label.
Do not use type="number" for money; it strips formatting and spinners misfire.
